# Nyay Saathi

> Nyay Saathi ("justice companion") is a free, open-source legal-help guide for people in India. You describe your problem in English or Hindi; it gives verified next steps, helplines and official links, checks whether you can get a free lawyer under section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, and drafts the letter you need. No sign-up, no tracking cookies, and nothing you type is saved. Built by Surge Software for Code for a Billion 2026 (MIT licence).

## Problems it covers
- Unpaid wages
- Consumer fraud and defective goods or services
- Violence at home
- Police not filing an FIR
- Cheque bounce
- A stuck government application (RTI)
- Court case status
- Land or tenancy disputes

## What it gives you
- Next steps from a curated, sourced knowledge base. It never makes up a law, deadline or phone number.
- Free legal aid eligibility (women, children, SC/ST, people with disabilities, industrial workers and low-income people qualify by law), with NALSA helpline 15100 and the District Legal Services Authority.
- Draft letters: legal aid application, RTI application, consumer complaint, wage demand, complaint to the Superintendent of Police.
- The cheapest path first: a written demand, consumer helpline grievance, RTI, legal-aid mediation or Lok Adalat.

Nyay Saathi gives legal information, not legal advice. For your case, talk to a lawyer; legal aid lawyers are free if you qualify.
